verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review is documented only as running on pull requests after they are opened (graphite-docs-4, graphite-docs-19, graphite-docs-27), and Graphite Chat works from the PR page. The only IDE surface in the evidence is a GUI for stacking (graphite-docs-14), with no mention of running AI review in the editor before pushing. The story applies to a code-review product, but nothing in the pack shows this capability.
